name: Tone Catch
description: Catch the tone under a person's words and tell what they truly feel.

name: Feeling Fence
description: Raise a fence of calm about the self so that another's fierce feeling cannot cross it.

name: Warm Bearing
description: Lend an ally a warm and steady bearing so that their words carry more trust.

name: Misread Tilt
description: Tilt a foe's reading of the user's mood so that they misjudge the next move.

name: Mood Anvil
description: Hold a heavy mood over a foe until their will to press the attack sinks.

name: Open Book
description: Read a foe's intent as an open book and tell the next three moves before they begin.

name: Mask Slip
description: Notice the moment a mask of calm slips and the real feeling shows through.

name: Cover Feeling
description: Cover the user's own feeling with a bland surface so that a probing sense is turned away.

name: Pace Match
description: Match the pace of a foe's spirit and step into the gap before they notice.

name: Courage Share
description: Pass a measure of the user's courage to an ally who is losing heart.

name: Fear Prod
description: Prod a hidden fear in a foe so that their strike goes wide.

name: Dread Draw
description: Draw the foe's hidden dread to the surface so that they see menace in everything.

name: Answer First
description: Read the intent in a foe's spirit and turn aside the blow before it begins.

name: Hurt Locate
description: Feel where a spirit has been hurt by the dullness that gathers there.

name: Fresh Calm
description: Wash an upset ally with fresh calm until the worst of the shock fades.

name: Spirit Prop
description: Prop up a sagging spirit with a clear sense of being backed.

name: Soft Armour
description: Wear a layer of calm as soft armour against sharp words and cruel intent.

name: Weight Lifting
description: Lift a heavy lingering mood or soul erosion from an ally or the self.

name: Mending Presence
description: Sit beside a hurt ally and let a mending presence work on the spirit.

name: Unease Spread
description: Spread a thin unease through a group of foes so that their ranks waver.

name: Nerve Test
description: Test the nerve of a foe by a small prod and learn how easily they break.

name: Steady Calm
description: Hold a calm that a rival's dread cannot pass.

name: Pulse Quicken
description: Quicken a foe's sense of danger until they start at shadows.

name: Creeping Dread
description: Let dread creep into a foe a little more each breath until their guard loosens.

name: Stampede Cue
description: Spark a sudden shared panic in a group so that they break formation.

name: Room Reading
description: Read the feeling kept in the walls and floor of a room.

name: Past Echo
description: Catch the faint echo of a past quarrel and learn who was angry and who afraid.

name: Mood Shed
description: Shed the clinging mood of a place from the user's spirit before it takes hold.

name: Place Calm
description: Settle the mood of a room until ill feeling no longer weighs on those in it.

name: Mood Fix
description: Fix a person's passing mood and follow it through crowded halls.

name: Memory Pressure
description: Wake the dread a room remembers and let it press on a foe who stands there.

name: Haunted Veil
description: Cloak the user in the quiet of a room long empty so that no seeking sense finds them.
